phase_description: Phase 1: Critical fixes for cover image upload and RLS policies

changes_made.issue: Cover images stored as DataURL instead of Supabase Storage URL
changes_made.fix_applied: Replaced handleCoverUpload() to upload images to 'public_assets' bucket and store Storage URLs
changes_made.root_cause: FileReader.readAsDataURL() used instead of Supabase Storage upload
changes_made.impact: Cover images now properly stored in Supabase Storage and persisted across sessions

changes_made.issue: Missing RLS policies for teachers to manage content_pages, challenges, and other critical tables
changes_made.fix_applied: Added comprehensive INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies for: content_pages, competitions, questions, challenges, challenge_levels, research_evaluations
changes_made.root_cause: Original migration only had basic storage and research_evaluations policies
changes_made.verification: SQL syntax checked - uses IF NOT EXISTS guards to avoid duplicates
changes_made.impact: Teachers can now perform CRUD operations on all critical dashboard tables

testing_performed.result: PASS - All files have valid JavaScript syntax

known_issues.issue: RLS policies are database changes that require deployment to Supabase
known_issues.action_required: User must apply migration 09 to remote Supabase instance

next_steps: Phase 2: Test CRUD operations for all dashboard sections
Phase 3: Fix remaining event listener and business logic issues
